scientific_integrity.claim: The exact sharp L1 and L-infinity norms coincide and equal 1+(s+1)/2*(1-2/(d*(s+1)))^s. Maximizing evaluations are exactly the coordinate vertices; sharp L-infinity sign inputs exist. scientific_integrity.limitations: No higher polynomial degrees, unequal face measures, arbitrary polytopes, or independent review. Full-facet and vertex boundary cases are already covered/elementary and not asserted as new. Unindexed specialist literature remains a priority risk.
scientific_integrity.proof_status: Analytical proof supplied; 1984 finite rational checker assertions additionally passed. No infinite computational certification.
scientific_integrity.scope: Continuous normalized Hausdorff measure on every (s-1)-skeleton of the regular cross-polytope in ambient dimension d>=3, with intermediate 2<=s<=d-1. Orthogonal L2 projector onto all affine functions.
